launchers.notes:
Installer 38: Android 15/16 fix, fairer summons and many bug fixes.
- Fixes the crash while loading on Android 15/16 phones (game runtime 122: after updating, tap Fix, then Install; your progress is kept).
- Summons: 5 stars or better 12% with one in every 10-pull; featured units are half of their tier; themed banners give only their featured 6 stars; the Blazing Festival step-up guarantees Naruto on step 9 and loops back to 1/9.
- 43 genuine banners rotate, 3 per launch, in a different order for each account.
- Fixes Begin Skip, the Ninja Road start error, and the Communication error on limit break, locking, awakening and enhancing (a declined enhance now shows a message instead).
- Fixes the 1-4 Graduation cutscene and nine others; element, character-count and affiliation objectives now count for 3 stars.
- Replays pay pearls as a Mission Clear gift, Drop Complete progresses, and Ninja Road pays its coins and stones.
- A daily Login Bonus with pearls, Granny coins, skip tickets and Ultimate Cup ramen, plus a one-time 1,000-pearl update gift.
- Giant Boss Rush returns, ultimate jutsu movies play again (Sakura's Team 7 cut-in among 90), and every event stage has real banner art.
- A full box never blocks summons, your own units can help, enhance gives 300% EXP, and summons start at luck 10.

launchers.notes:
Hotfix for installer 38.
- Fixes the endless loading in the Gift Box during Kakashi's Captain Exam tutorial. The 1,000-pearl update gift now arrives at the first start after the tutorial.
- Summoned characters now arrive as a fresh copy at Level 1 with luck 10 in every profile. All data summons no longer arrive fully maxed.

channelNotes.beta:
Hotpatch 39 (0.27.1-grind-rc) for installer 38.
- Fixed: the Gift Box loaded forever during Kakashi's Captain Exam tutorial. The 1,000-pearl update gift now arrives at the first start after the tutorial.
- Fixed: summons in the All data profile arrived fully maxed. Every summon now gives a fresh Level 1 character with luck 10, in both profiles.
- Coming from installer 37? After updating, tap Fix, then Install, to get the Android 15/16 fix (game runtime 122). Your progress is kept.
channelNotes.stable:
Installer 39 (0.27.1-grind-rc) is now the stable release.
- Fixes the crash while loading on Android 15/16 phones (game runtime 122: after updating, tap Fix, then Install; your progress is kept).
- Fairer summons: 5 stars or better 12% with one in every 10-pull; themed banners give only their featured 6 stars; the Blazing Festival step-up guarantees Naruto on step 9 and loops back.
- 43 genuine banners rotate in a different order for each account, and every event stage has real banner art.
- A daily Login Bonus, Giant Boss Rush, ultimate jutsu movies, and pearls on every replay.
- Fixes Begin Skip, Ninja Road starts, story cutscenes, 3-star objectives, and the Communication error on limit break, locking, awakening and enhancing.
- Summons give a fresh Level 1 character with luck 10, and the tutorial's Gift Box no longer loads forever.

launchers.notes:
Installer 40 (0.28-teams-rc): teams, My Helper, 3x speed and fixes.
- Battle speed cycles 1x, 2x and 3x, and the button shows x2 and x3 (game runtime 124: after updating, tap Fix, then Install; your progress is kept).
- Team Setup has 7 teams: switch with the arrows, and the team you pick is the one that fights.
- Select A Helper shows just My Helper (your Helper Setting unit or your strongest), and drop luck counts your three front-row units.
- Phantom Castle: a daily Reset Progress bar on the Castle screen, and Castle stamina refills with 1 Ninja Pearl.
- A full character box offers Expand (1 pearl = 5 slots) or Sell units, and Shop > Expand Character List adds slots you can see.
- Fixes the Present Box loading forever on some phone languages; buying pearls no longer sends you to the title.
- 12 more original summon banners, and the 4th Anniversary Naruto and Sasuke banners are always open.
- The launcher ends the session by itself when the game exits; your save is kept.
